system.description:
Swift in travel and steadfast in war. Pe B3(4), Wi B2, Ag B3, Sp B8, Po B5, Fo B6. Hea B5, Ste B5, Ref B3, MW B12 (Tough). Hesitation 7 (Determined), Stride 13. Skills: Mounted Combat Training, Rider Training, Intimidation B3, Foraging B4. Traits: Good Bone, Fleet of Hoof, Obedient, Loyal, Tough, Brute and Determined, plus Long-Limbed, Keen Hearing, Hooved, Ungulate.

Source: Burning Wheel Gold Revised, p. 158
